defs.def: to do things in a particular way 表现

ex.s: More generally, social instincts motivate us to learn how to behave in a socially complex world.
ex.t: 更普遍地说，社会本能促使我们学习如何在这个社会复杂的世界中行事。

ex.s: After a while, she   51   for the way she behaved at the beginning.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，她为自己起初的行为方式___51___。

ex.s: Multiple genes behaved differently, depending on whether someone had eaten or not before walking.
ex.t: 多个基因的表现因人是否在步行前进食而有所不同。

defs.def: to do things in a way that people think is correct or polite 表现得体；有礼貌

ex.s: Cyberbullies often people who behave foolishly online.
ex.t: 网络欺凌者通常是行为愚蠢的在线用户。

ex.s: She’s taught how to behave perfectly.
ex.t: 她被教导如何举止得体。

ex.s: Name Prize for Wang Xiaoding Wu Lei Li Li Zhang Hong best in science top scores all year excellent class monitor most well-behaved student in the class Hi, everyone!
ex.t: 姓名 奖项 王晓丁 吴磊 李莉 张宏 科学最佳 全年最高分 优秀班长 班里最守规矩的学生 大家好！

ex.s: The Master said, “A gentleman takes as much trouble to discover what is right as lesser men take to discover what will pay.” Propriety Always behave respectfully towards others.
ex.t: 子曰："君子喻于义，小人喻于利。" 礼 始终恭敬待人。

defs.def: behaving in the way mentioned 构成形容词
to naturally react, move, etc. in a particular way 作某种自然反应（或变化等）

ex.s: This ability to choose how we behave and respond is a great gift.
ex.t: 这种选择我们如何行为和反应的能力是一份伟大的礼物。
